stem: Teresa's comments influence the theme of the story because they show that she —

options.label: A

options.label: B

visual_elements: "But I was born to do the long jump. My instinct is to jump," Teresa said as she sat on a bench. "When I'm on the Olympic team, you'll see what I mean."
